objects.name: bc_sales_order_item_fact_v
objects.description: Zentraler Auftrags-Fact, angereichert um Kunden- und Materialattribute.

objects.name: bc_delivery_performance_fact_v
objects.description: Liefertreue je Lieferung; im Aufbau, noch nicht als Boundary-Contract zertifiziert.

objects.name: bc_revenue_monthly_fact_v
objects.description: Umsatz je Periode, Vertriebsorg und Warengruppe inkl. Konzernwährung.

sqlReconstruction.sql:
CREATE VIEW "bc_revenue_monthly_fact_v" AS
SELECT
    TO_VARCHAR("f"."ORDER_DATE") AS "FISCAL_YEAR_MONTH",
    "f"."SALES_ORG" AS "SALES_ORG",
    "f"."REGION_CODE" AS "REGION_CODE",
    "f"."MATERIAL_GROUP" AS "PRODUCT_GROUP",
    SUM("f"."NET_AMOUNT") AS "GROSS_REVENUE",
    "f"."NET_AMOUNT" * "r"."EXCHANGE_RATE" AS "REVENUE_EUR",
    COUNT("f"."SALES_ORDER_ID") AS "ORDER_COUNT",
    "r"."TO_CURRENCY" AS "CURRENCY",
    MAX("f"."CHANGED_AT") AS "CHANGED_AT"
FROM "bc_sales_order_item_fact_v" AS "f"
  INNER JOIN "ic_exchange_rate_v" AS "r"
    ON "f"."CURRENCY" = "r"."FROM_CURRENCY";

objects.name: bc_budget_actual_fact_v
objects.description: Gegenüberstellung von Ist-Umsatz und Budget je Periode und Warengruppe.

sqlReconstruction.sql:
CREATE VIEW "bc_budget_actual_fact_v" AS
SELECT
    "b"."FISCAL_YEAR" AS "FISCAL_YEAR",
    "b"."FISCAL_PERIOD" AS "FISCAL_PERIOD",
    "b"."SALES_ORG" AS "SALES_ORG",
    "b"."PRODUCT_GROUP" AS "PRODUCT_GROUP",
    "a"."REVENUE_EUR" AS "ACTUAL_AMOUNT",
    "b"."BUDGET_AMOUNT" AS "BUDGET_AMOUNT",
    "a"."REVENUE_EUR" - "b"."BUDGET_AMOUNT" AS "VARIANCE_AMOUNT",
    "b"."CURRENCY" AS "CURRENCY",
    "a"."CHANGED_AT" AS "CHANGED_AT"
FROM "bc_revenue_monthly_fact_v" AS "a"
  INNER JOIN "ic_budget_plan_v" AS "b"
    ON "a"."SALES_ORG" = "b"."SALES_ORG";
